subject: Linguistics
title: Language Revitalization
description: A quick, practical guide to Language Revitalization.

hook.text: Hebrew was a dead language for daily use—then Israel revived it as a mother tongue for millions.

buildup.text: Language revitalization aims to restore an endangered or dormant language to active community use.

discovery.text: Strategies include immersion schools, master-apprentice programs, and digital media in the language.

twist.text: Welsh went from near-death to having a million speakers—thanks to TV, schools, and policy support.

climax.text: Successful revitalization requires community will, institutional support, and daily use contexts.

punchline.text: Languages can come back—if communities choose to bring them.
